The '''Skustell Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] located within the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skustell/Legends|Skustell]].
